digest.component_or_area: Quality audit remediation: CI reliability, documentation, module decomposition, and type safety
propositions: Python 3.11 xdist worker reliability issue in test_opcert_service_app caused by pytest-xdist teardown race under CPU/memory contention, root-caused as benign post-results noise
User-facing assignee documentation example does not teach a Jira-resolvable identity consistent with docs/config.md
Near-cap modules structured_run.py, compact.py, and event_append.py mix responsibilities across layers and require decomposition by responsibility with preserved public import paths

Graph blocker subsystem contains duplicated infrastructure and high-complexity functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) that require centralized traversal layer
attest package lacks full type annotations under mypy --disallow-untyped-defs
Quality ratchets prevent regression but not ongoing creep; systematic early-warning margins are needed to prevent modules from approaching the 800 LOC cap
